name: conduit-mcp
description: MCP server and SSE event bus for the pipeline system. Central authority for pipeline state.
notes: Central pipeline authority — receipt-first state machine

name: nebula-mcp
description: MCP Server for Nebula RMS — exposes systems, subsystems, features, and requirements via MCP tools

name: terrain-mcp
description: MCP server for infrastructure topology — queries the terrain PostgreSQL schema to report on services, servers, MCP servers, and CLI tools. Provides tools: terrain_list_servers, terrain_list_mcp_servers, terrain_list_runnable_services, terrain_list_cli_tools, terrain_get_service_status, terrain_is_running, terrain_infrastructure_summary, terrain_list_dependencies.
health: direct PG query — no HTTP health endpoint
notes: Infrastructure MCP — answers service status questions without inference overhead

name: tackle-mcp
description: MCP server for the tackle AI configuration registry (providers, harnesses, models, role configs) plus Role Memory Procedure Registry tools (memory_get_procedures, memory_get_procedure, memory_check_since, memory_refresh)
notes: AI config registry + memory-mcp tools — reads Redis cache (populated by role-memory-srv :3500)

name: peb-mcp
description: MCP facade for PEB Spring Boot Kernel — governance, state management, and orchestration backend (Merkle-tree state ledger)
health: direct kernel query — no HTTP health endpoint
notes: PEB kernel MCP interface — stdio transport, proxies to :8080 kernel

name: knowledge-mcp
description: MCP server for the knowledge schema — exposes graph_entities, graph_edges, graph_cross_references, and graph_migrations via MCP tools (knowledge_list_entities, knowledge_get_entity, knowledge_list_edges, knowledge_get_entity_relations, knowledge_list_cross_references, knowledge_list_migrations, knowledge_semantic_search, knowledge_graph_summary)
health: direct PG query — no HTTP health endpoint
notes: Knowledge graph MCP interface — stdio transport, direct PostgreSQL to knowledge schema
